description: This file declares the interface and classes for a GStreamer source component (GstSrc) within the Rialto media server. It includes class definitions, factory pattern implementation, and external dependencies related to GStreamer and media streaming.

classes.name: GstSrcFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing instances of IGstSrc.

classes.name: GstSrc
classes.description: Implementation of the IGstSrc interface, managing GStreamer source elements and related operations.

methods.name: getGstSrc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the IGstSrc instance managed by the factory.

methods.name: setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Sets up and adds an application source to the GStreamer pipeline with specified stream info and callbacks.

methods.name: allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Indicates that all application sources have been added to the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: createPayloader
methods.description: Creates and returns a GStreamer payloader element.
